title: Heap sort in place
summary: Build a max-heap bottom up. Swap the maximum into the sorted suffix, then restore the heap within its new boundary.
code: if child + 1 < end and values[child] < values[child + 1]:
triggers: in-place sorting with a worst-case time bound
repeatedly move the maximum to the end
prompts: Sort a fixed buffer of scores with constant auxiliary storage.
Produce ascending ranks by repeatedly moving the current winner out of a binary heap.
invariant: The active prefix is a max-heap before each extraction, and the suffix is already sorted.
mantra: Choose the larger child and shrink the heap after each swap.
pitfalls: Use the active end when checking for a right child. The sorted suffix is off limits.

anchors.name: Sort an Array
anchors.trick: Heapify bottom up and extract into the same array.

mutations.explanation: Pulls the extracted maximum back into the active heap.
